reviews.evidence: Three-tier memory control plane covers runtime context, documents, multi-provider spaces, supervised writes, recall, routing, Web/headless surfaces, and a verified walkthrough with concrete screenshots.
reviews.concern: External-provider semantics vary, and the README explicitly lacks deterministic secret scanning.

reviews.evidence: Comprehensive terminal workspace with session branching/rewind, image flow, approvals, panels, LSP tools, model controls, commands, shortcuts, and detailed recovery guidance.
reviews.concern: Most content is a feature/reference inventory rather than explicit use-case scenarios, and no concrete in-README UI output is shown beyond promotional material.

reviews.evidence: Provides a draggable session-and-branch map, selected-text follow-ups, editable prompts, native-session synchronization, and two screenshots showing map and entry states.
reviews.concern: The README gives only a basic happy path and little troubleshooting or advanced operational guidance.

reviews.evidence: Own site workflow combines structured DSH lessons, an automatically synchronized plugin index, guides/glossary, rankings, data regeneration, and a topic-based submission path.
reviews.concern: No documented catalog search/filter or verification method is shown, and concrete marketplace results are only available through the external live site.

reviews.evidence: Extensive CLI spans OAuth, meeting lifecycle, invitees, recordings/transcripts, reports, live controls, contacts, diagnostics, pagination, approval preview/commit, and async export workflows.
reviews.concern: Concrete output samples cover only selected commands, and the README provides no validation or automated-test evidence.

reviews.evidence: End-to-end prompt generation, conversational image editing, multi-turn reuse, workspace saving, multi-provider setup, and searchable gallery management are demonstrated across distinct screenshots.
reviews.concern: Provider compatibility is documented, but failure behavior, security boundaries, limits, and troubleshooting are largely absent.

reviews.evidence: Unusually complete pipeline covers aggregation, safety/license curation, quality and dedup, export, retrieval/reranking, serving, benchmarks, API use, self-hosting, corpus building, and host adapters with measured results and concrete output.
reviews.concern: The full catalog remains hosted and closed; the downloadable corpus is only a 1,000-skill demo, and self-hosted model endpoints are not SkillHub-API compatible.

reviews.evidence: The catalog itself provides multilingual, categorized browsing plus unusually specific curation notes on project shape, compatibility baselines, maturity, security caveats, and conflicting validation signals.
reviews.concern: It documents no catalog-native search, submission, or reproducible refresh/verification workflow; operational commands mostly exercise linked DSH resources and earn no catalog usage credit.

reviews.evidence: Covers the full lab research lifecycle from literature and idea review through GPU experiments, collaborative LaTeX writing, citation/fact review, and resumable human-gated Voyages, with a video tour and read-only live system.
reviews.concern: Deployment and development are actionable, but the README lacks a step-by-step happy path for conducting a real research Voyage.

reviews.evidence: One clear tool turns HTML fragments into persistent interactive conversation cards, with a complete prompt-to-card path, wide mode, and a meaningful video demonstration for simulations, charts, comparisons, and mockups.
reviews.concern: Capability remains a single narrow renderer, with only one demonstration and no test or troubleshooting evidence.
